signals.text: Very nice bowtie.  Great price.  Very adjustable (wide range), my son should be able to wear for quite a while. Thanks!

I purchased these for facial headbands and was surprised to find the bow knot was wired - but it's cute that you can alter the bow knot because they are wired.  The colors are bright - but not florescent.  Stretchy and comfortable.  I like them and would purchase them again.
Do like These pants from johnnny,  did wish they came in shorter length.  about  3" to long
